out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection. FOOD EMPLOYEE CFM CERTIFICATE IS EXPIRED.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CDI: FOOD EMPLOYEE WITH CFM CERTIFICATION SHOWED UP DURING THE INSPECTION. ENSURE AT LEAST ONE PERSON IS PRESENT AT ALL TIMES THAT HOLDS A CFM CERTIFICATE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the bar area being used to store a strainer.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: STRAINER WAS REMOVED. ENSURE HAND SINK IS ONLY USED FOR HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED CHEMICAL SPRAY BOTTLES IMPROPERLY STORED IN THE FOLLOWING PLACES: 1) ON A PREP TABLE NEAR EQUIPMENT 2) OVER MEAT SLICER. 3) OVER SINGLE USE ARTICLES IN THE BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: PIC RELOCATED ALL THE SPRAY BOTTLES.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED FRUIT FLIES NEAR THE PIZZA OVEN, PLUMBING OF THE 3COMP SINK, AND BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. CONDUCT PEST SERVICE BY A CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL COMPANY BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION BY OCTOBER 28, 2026.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE SWEATERS ON PACKAGED FOODS AT THE BACK OF THE KITCHEN AND SINGLE USE ARTICLES ON SHELVING NEAR THE BACK DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. REMOVE ALL ITEMS. CREATE A DESIGNATED SPACE FOR EMPLOYEE BELONGINGS BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap at the bar hand washing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the chlorine and water solution in the spray bottle was not measurable as the test paper immediately turned white indicating the solution was over 200 ppm chlorine. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of the chlorine and water solution at between 50 and 200ppm at all times. Using too strong a concentration can lead to problems. Verify the. concentration of this solution by using the appropriate test kit. The EHS educated the PIC and the CFM on how to properly mix this solution. The solution was discarded and remixed properly. CDI.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. There was an unlabeled spray bottle of a yellowish solution near the three compartment sink. The PIC stated it was a chlorine and water solution for cleaning the cutting boards.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The PIC labeled the bottle during the inspection to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Clean plates on at the wait station were found displayed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward. All other items (utensils, cups, etc.) were either inverted or wrapped in napkins, which is acceptable.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. Clean plates should be covered or inverted in this area to protect them from contamination. The EHS discussed this with the PIC. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a wiping cloth solution bucket stored on the same shelf with food and food equipment.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. This was corrected by moving the container to the floor.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: there were several large ingredient containers that were not labeled. A spray bottle of water was not labeled. Squeeze bottles of olive oil and dressings were unlabeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The person in charge corrected this by labeling all the containers during the inspection.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: There were several drain flies present behind the bar area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Please contact your pest control operator and have them address the flies issues within 10 days. Pupatella Neapolitan Pizza (Inspection Date: 10/20/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: a bowl was being used to portion cooked pasta and the bowl was left in the pasta. A handled scoop was being used to scoop sugar, but the handle was left in the sugar.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. To limit hand contact with foods, used handled utensils and keep the handles out of the food. Also, don’t use bowls to dispense foods unless only used once. Use a handled utensil instead. The person in charge corrected both of the issues during the inspection.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved splitter on the mop sink hose faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The person in charge corrected this by ordering a HydroSystems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve backflow preventer. Please install the unit after received and let your EHS know.

violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the cook-line and ware washing area was blocked, preventing easy access by employees for proper handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI-Utensils soiled utensils large reach can serving as a table, were removed from the path to the sink, during n the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cook-line/kitchen was being used to wash small utensils clogging the sink with food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.

violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. The certified foods manager placed an on lioness order for an electronic/digital thermometer, during the inspection.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has last year’s 2024 health permit displayed, missing current 2025 health permit posted within facility.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. CONTACT HEALTH DEPARTMENT TO REQUEST COPY OF 2025 HEALTH PERMIT, DISPLAY WITHIN FACILITY.
